delivery_phases.spec_focus: Database schema, store API, HTTP handler implementation

validation.spec_summary: Link Shelf MVP: a minimal bookmark manager app with Go/SQLite backend and static frontend. Must implement /api/links endpoints (GET/POST/DELETE) with validation, SQLite storage (schema.go/store.go), and /web UI (CRUD via JavaScript). Passes with go test ./... and HTTP server serving UI on :8080. Uses package-level store API, no structs. Test with memory DB if optional tests added.
